reason: Minimum sufficient correctness and descriptive performance checks; prioritize fewer experiments.

controller_followup.diagnostics: Full captured-route CPU differential replay; one short P1 GPU profile each for C1/C2 after primary timing.
controller_followup.performance_scope: One matched full generation per policy/controller; descriptive latency only, no repeatability or small-speedup claim.

limitations: B8/B16 two repeats provide descriptive checks, not a well-powered performance conclusion.
Forward/reverse order counterbalances endpoints but keeps P1 in the middle; full position balance is sacrificed explicitly to reduce work.
No B4/B16 controller expansion, even if B8 passes the prior material-reduction gate.
Controller stage uses one fresh matched sample per policy/variant, no policy/controller order balancing; exact trajectory parity replaces repetitions for correctness, not for timing confidence.
